best: Titled blocks with clear power-stage drawings: the 3V3 buck, the four-switch H-bridge stage and the BQ25756 support network read as tidy textbook-style circuits with legible values.
worst: USB sheets connect many parts only by labels (USB-C connector, TPD6S300, PD controller, decoupling caps marked 'for U401...') so reviewing means tracing nets by name; TPS25751 GPIO/GND pins have stacked ground symbols and overlapping pin numbers
Cells sheet has many isolated label-only parts (ESD caps, WAKE pull-up, PACK_CMID caps, test-point grid) and the gauge's long fan-in bus of wires to U101 is hard to follow
Poor use of space: 3V3 and MCU sheets are mostly empty while the USB sheets cram small text into a large page; MCU antenna pi-match and debug connectors tie to the module only by labels
